snippet.title: ONETALE VERSION 2 RELEASE VIDEO
snippet.description:
https://gamejolt.com/games/Onetale/726821

[The messiah has come home.]

[Another adventure awaits them, however.]

[They have heard stories of the mountain near their village.]

[Stories of people who never came back down.]

[Curious, they decide to venture upwards to see the validity of these rumors.]

[...]

[They were true.]

an #undertale #mod by theshiberealm

----------------------------------------

Features:

--Niko from #Oneshot is now fully playable in Undertale! All sprites have been edited to include the funny little NOT cat person!

-- a LOT of new graphics have been added.

-- all sprites that even MENTION frisk have been replaced with Niko

-- AN ACTUAL RUN BUTTON

-- a certain route has had a massive overhaul.

-- new name Easter eggs have been added, try some oneshot characters! (and maybe, some of the people in the credits hehehehe)

-- also due to the new easter eggs you can now have 10 characters for your name instead

of 6! (WARNING, using all 10 characters WILL break some things, nothing will crash though basically just text wrapping and some parts of the hud overlapping)

-- New Text and New Npcs!

-- basically if you want Niko oneshot in your undertale game, this is the mod to have :)

CREDITS:

Director:

@𝑻𝒉𝒆𝑺𝒉𝒊𝒃𝒆𝑹𝒆𝒂𝒍𝒎 - Creator, Coding, Sprite editing, basically all the dumb stuff lmao.

Artists

@𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐳𝐳𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐨𝐱__ aka chaz: Beta Tester, Sprite Artist, Writer, The creator of Misfire, Ideas, advice. (really cool guy check him out)

𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐀𝐧𝐱𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐁𝐞𝐚𝐧 aka  on Reddit and Discord - Additional Sprite Work.

@𝐒𝐦𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐲𝐛𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐞𝟏 aka smilly: Sprite artist, creator of Kurimu, Ideas, advice.

𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐟𝐢𝐬𝐡𝟔𝟒 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐡𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐛𝐚𝐠𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝 on Youtube: creators of Asriel Hug sprites.

@𝗧𝗢𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗭𝗦: Creator of Charus face sprite

@𝗗𝗲𝗳𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝟲𝟲𝘅𝟮: Creator of a Kurimu sprite. which one? uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

Composers

@𝐂𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐫𝐲_𝐒𝐨𝐝𝐚 aka sodder: Composer of New music tracks, all 3 can be found within the game.

@𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗲𝟭𝟰𝟯𝟰: Creator of Hikari, Used with permission from them! https://soundcloud.com/xtgq5ljetvav/mixdown-6

Beta Testers

@𝐂𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐦 aka cinder: Beta Tester, Ideas, advice,  also helped keep the mod going.

@𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐳𝐳𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐨𝐱__ (again)

Frutt:

@𝐟𝐫𝐮𝐭𝐭𝐲𝐦𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 aka frutty: Ideas, advice, helped with name screen ideas.

Additional Credits:

𝐔𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐞 𝐁𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐏𝐢𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐬: Credit for A LOT of code used in this mod, I cannot understate how much help this mod gave me. with permission from blaize.mayes. Thanks again!

The Entire Thunderdome Discord server, without them this mod wouldn't have been possible!

all the people in the name easter egg screen (what? you didn't think there would be

new name easter eggs?)

@𝐋𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐫𝐫𝐫 aka luther: existing :)

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐭 𝐀𝐟𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐦: Original artists of shadow niko sprites. Please support the devs. They are doing god's work.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐭 𝐅𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐓𝐞𝐚𝐦: some sprites come from this game. please support these devs as well. Both fan projects deserve support!

thank you for allowing me to use them!

𝐫/𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐫/𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐦𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬: helping me figure out how undertalemodtool works

(seriously these guys helped me figure out so much)

Creator of the HP font: is.gd/uthpfont

(IF IM MISSING ANYONE WHO ISN'T LISTED HERE, PLEASE CONTACT ME SO I CAN ADD YOU! THIS HAS BEEN IN DEVELOPMENT FOR A WHILE, SO I MAY HAVE FORGOTTEN SOME PEOPLE!!!)

The original Oneshot dev team, Future Cat

Nightmargin

Eliza Velasquez

Michael Shirt

Degica

Mark Conforti

Toby Fox: The creation of Undertale, pretty cool guy i think

And You :)

ALSO REPORT BUGS TO ME CAUSE I HAVE NO IDEA IF I BROKE ANYTHING

REPORT THEM HERE
@TheShibeRealm
 (yes my twitter i will probably reply within 1 second)

Remember: This mod is INCOMPLETE which means that there may be some jank to it.
